location.name: Monumental Heritage Staircase, Albert Hall North Forecourt

annotations.label: Stairs / Steps
annotations.accessibility_impact: 18 steep heritage sandstone steps with no curb cut ramp. Complete barrier for wheelchair and stroller navigation.
annotations.notes: Verified in person at Albert Hall North Terrace entrance. Diverts wheelchair routes toward Rose Garden ramped promenade.

annotations.label: Missing Kerb Ramp
annotations.accessibility_impact: Vertical step drop > 15cm from upper promenade with no transition ramp.
annotations.notes: Transition curb cut required to connect with lower plaza level.
